digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — P6 acceptance-criteria quality linting
propositions: Acceptance criteria with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) must be tagged [operator-attested] but often are not, causing plan-review gate verification failures until the tag is retroactively added.

A deterministic lexicon-based advisory lint must flag AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers without the [operator-attested] tag at plan time, surfacing the defect before claim submission.

The lint must extend p6_ac_quality (existing P6 family DET check), remain advisory/non-blocking, keep DET_CHECKS at exactly 9, require no criteria_routing.json entry, and share a single canonical _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE regex with the completion-verifier enrichment path.

The deterministic eval over the frozen 3091-item historical AC corpus from 556 E1 outcome-corpus tickets must achieve ≥70% precision on a ≥50-item flagged sample, ≤5% flag rate, and both known cases (115b, 8c4f) must fire, with eval results committed before lint activation in git ancestry.
Both known-case AC items (tickets 115b and 8c4f) with tag stripped must trigger the detector as positive fixtures, and already-tagged items must not flag, verified by unit tests.

The lint and workflow_ops must agree on tag recognition by construction: det_operator_attested owns _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and workflow_ops imports it as _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_AC_RE (same object identity).
